name: Anna Catharine Doll
bioAdditions: FamilySearch gives Anna Catharina's birth date as 1 Jan 1757 (baptized 22 Feb 1757 at Tohickon), her marriage in 1775 to Capt. Lewis Stecher Sr. (1743-1821), with children in Plainfield and Forks Twps from 1776, and her death in 1799. Find a Grave indexes her as 'Anna Catharine Doll Stacher' (S1).
